newsitem.title: USA: Playtex stake lifted by Blum-led group.
newsitem.headline: Playtex stake lifted by Blum-led group.

text.p: A group led by San Francisco investment adviser Richard Blum on Thursday said it raised its stake in Playtex Products Inc to 3,963,800 common shares, or 7.8 percent.

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the purchase of 602,800 shares between April 30 and June 10 with prices ranging from $9.25 to $9.63 each.
Playtex, based in Westport, Conn., manufactures and distributes a variety of personal care products.
